Клостебола Ацетат C21H29ClO3 = 364.9. CAS — 1093-58-9 (clostebol); 855-19-6 (clostebol ace- tate). (clostebol) Profile Clostebol acetate has anabolic properties (see Testosterone, p.2129) and has been given by intramuscular injection and orally. It has also been applied topically to wounds and ulcers, and has been used as an ophthalmological preparation.
